The conversion speed is certainly the highest for flash ADCs. It is the lowest for integrating
ADCs. However, the resolution of the latter ones can be much higher.
Sigma-delta (or oversampling) converters can also reach high resolutions. All the others suffer
from matching and are limited to 12–14 bits.
Various Figures of Merit are used for the comparison of the performance. The one shown is
mainly used for oversampling converters, sometimes with the peak SNR instead of the DR.
